requirements.notes: DISCREPANCY vs. our existing test data: our test data records a single fixed value of marginTopMm=4mm. The real official source states a RANGE of 3mm-5mm (头顶至相片上边距离在3mm至5mm之间), not a fixed 4mm value. 4mm is the midpoint of the real range but the rule itself is a tolerance band, not a single number.
